title: Wobbly Life visual reference corpus
purpose: Record actionable, source-grounded Wobbly Life character cues for original Sower art direction.

sources.note: User-provided reference, decoded to PNG for inspection; original payload was AVIF despite its filename. Reference-only; do not use as runtime texture or copy the character mesh.

evidence.quote: Open-world sandbox filled with mini-games, toys, secrets and SO MUCH more
+50 unique missions & jobs with exclusive rewards to unlock, alone or with friends
+250 clothes items to show-off in your wobbly look

sources.note: Corroborates play, job, toy and outfit context only; it does not establish body proportions, anatomy, facial design or specific movement mechanics.

traits.visualEvidence: The large foreground figure has a smooth, rounded head that flows into a compact torso without a visible neck; the overall outline is broad at the upper body and narrows into separated legs.
traits.interpretation: A compact, soft toy-like body reads before fine anatomy.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Use a distinct but softly joined head-and-body silhouette with rounded transitions; create a new Sower contour rather than copying the source figure.

traits.visualEvidence: The foreground yellow face shows two small, dark, round eyes and no clearly visible mouth, nose, brows or other facial marks.
traits.interpretation: Sparse facial information keeps the expression open and readable at a distance.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Keep the face calm and legible with very few marks; use original eye spacing and avoid importing a specific Wobbly face.

traits.visualEvidence: The main figure's torso is a smooth, lightly tapered mass with no visible garment seams or exposed mechanical joints.
traits.interpretation: Large uninterrupted color areas support a clean, readable character block.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Build the Sower torso from a few broad color fields and rounded surfaces; express helper identity with a new chest mark or accessory, not copied graphics.

traits.visualEvidence: Both arms extend well away from the torso in the foreground pose. They look smooth and tube-like, with no visible elbows, fingers or separate hand shapes.
traits.interpretation: The long simple arm outline is a major contributor to the open pose and can create deep gaps beside the body.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Borrow the clarity of a simple arm silhouette but make Sower limb lengths and endpoints original; ensure the arm-to-body gap remains readable in front, side and candy views.

traits.visualEvidence: The two legs are separated by a visible triangular opening and end in broad, simplified feet without distinct shoes or toes on the main character.
traits.interpretation: A clear gap makes the stance legible, while a low-detail foot keeps the lower silhouette uncomplicated.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Preserve a readable leg split in the chosen pose and simplify feet into sturdy original forms; do not recreate the reference's exact stance.

traits.visualEvidence: The large figure is saturated yellow, with orange-gold shading around side and lower contours; the eyes are near-black. The surrounding image contains bright green land and pale blue sky, so background colors should not be mistaken for the character palette.
traits.interpretation: Warm hue shifts separate rounded forms while keeping the character immediately visible against the scene.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Use the goat4 cream/orange/cocoa preference anchor for Sower's base colors, and treat Wobbly's yellow-to-orange value separation only as a broad shading cue.

traits.visualEvidence: In this still image the main character holds both arms high and outward, with legs apart and the face directed toward the viewer.
traits.interpretation: The static gesture reads as welcoming or celebratory, but one frame cannot demonstrate a motion cycle, joint mechanics or a general personality.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Use an open-arm greeting as one optional Sower pose, then define distinct original poses for tending, carrying or helping; do not claim this still proves Wobbly animation behavior.

traits.visualEvidence: The supplied still includes a hard hat, reflective-looking vest and dark trousers; the official fishing screenshot shows two different head accessories; the snow screenshot shows two back-facing characters with distinct winter hats and outfits.
traits.interpretation: Outfits and headwear vary over a recurring rounded base character.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Keep Sower role variation detachable and original: a simple helper accessory or color block can signal a task without changing the base character silhouette.

traits.visualEvidence: The official page says the game has more than 250 clothing items.
traits.interpretation: Official text supports broad outfit variety but does not describe the construction of any particular outfit shown in the screenshots.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Allow Sower outfit accents to change while retaining a stable original base form.

traits.visualEvidence: The fishing screenshot catches two characters behind a boat rail with rods angled out across the water; the snow screenshot catches two characters facing away, one standing on a snowy path and one partly down in the snow.
traits.interpretation: The stills show distinct activity poses and viewpoints, not how a character transitions between them or what rigging is used.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Develop a few clear, original Sower helper poses such as carrying or reaching, and judge each from front and back; do not infer motion timing from these frames.

traits.visualEvidence: The official page describes an open-world sandbox with mini-games and toys, and missions and jobs.
traits.interpretation: The character design is presented in a playful activity-rich setting; this contextual evidence does not establish any particular character anatomy or motion.
traits.originalSowerTranslation: Give the Sower a clear helper action or prop in concept art, but design original props and avoid treating context as evidence for a copied body feature.

high: Round, simplified character masses and an immediately readable pose.
Very sparse facial marks and broad, uninterrupted color regions.
medium: Smooth transitions between head, torso and limbs while retaining an original Sower silhouette.
Warm light-to-shadow color shifts informed by Wobbly's yellow/orange rendering and the separate goat4 cream/orange/cocoa preference anchor.
low: Wobbly-specific long, extended limb proportions, since they create candy-thin bridges and pronounced arm/torso undercuts.
Any specific Wobbly face, outfit, model or source-scene detail.

candyConstraints.risk: The reference's long, slim arm silhouette can become a fragile bridge or a narrow connection in a candy simplification.
candyConstraints.guidance: Shorten or thicken the Sower arm, or bring it closer to the torso while preserving a visible arm contour. Treat this as a design readability cue, not manufacturing validation.

candyConstraints.risk: A deep gap beneath an outward arm creates an undercut in a simplified solid form and can visually disconnect the arm.
candyConstraints.guidance: Use a shallow rounded recess or close the gap with a broad transition. Keep enough separation in the illustration to read the pose.

candyConstraints.risk: A deep triangular opening between separated legs can leave a thin waist of material or an exaggerated undercut in a candy study.
candyConstraints.guidance: Reduce the gap depth and round its apex; preserve a clear leg split without carrying the reference pose literally.

candyConstraints.risk: Tiny dot eyes or shallow face marks may disappear when the figure is simplified.
candyConstraints.guidance: Use fewer, larger, deeper-relief marks in concept studies while retaining original Sower facial placement.

unknowns: The supplied still does not establish how the character walks, waves, bends, falls or articulates at joints.
The official page text cited here does not specify character geometry, limb proportions, palette rules or animation mechanics.
No anatomy measurements, physical candy tolerances or manufacturing validation are inferred from these references.
